pages.text: Switches a lever on or off.$(br2)A block that is not a lever raises INVALID_ARGUMENT. Levers on the sheets of the c0de dimension can't be changed (PERMISSION_DENIED).
$(li)$(1)position$() STRUCT c0de/minecraft/POSITION: where the lever is$(li)$(1)on$() BOOLEAN: true to switch it on, false to switch it off
$(1)CALL c0de/minecraft/SET_LEVER$(br)  PARAMETER position lever ;$(br)  PARAMETER on TRUE ;$()
